newsitem.title: UK: Natwest may offer gas to customers - report.
newsitem.headline: Natwest may offer gas to customers - report.

text.p: More than six million customers of National Westminster Bank Plc may be offered gas and electricity under an alliance being forged between the British bank and Eastern Group, a newspaper reported on Friday.

Eastern, part of former Hanson Plc subsidiary Energy Group Plc, will initially market energy to bank employees and their relatives in areas of southern England where gas is sold competitively, The Times said.
If the trials are successful they may be extended to NatWest customers as competition in the gas market goes nationwide, the newspaper said.
